name: UGC try-on · mirror turn
description: A creator films themselves in a mirror wearing the item and turns once so the fit reads. Use it for clothing, bags, watches and anything worn.
prompt: {{ creator }} films themselves in a full-length mirror in a {{ setting }}, wearing {{ item }}, and turns once slowly so the fit reads from the front and the side. Phone held in one hand, daylight, natural posture, no posing for a camera crew. The item keeps its exact colour and cut. No captions, no text on screen.
negative_prompt: captions, on-screen text, watermark, studio lighting, changed garment colour
